newsitem.title: USA: Lousiana Land ups Madison natgas to 1 tln cu feet.
newsitem.headline: Lousiana Land ups Madison natgas to 1 tln cu feet.

text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co has increased estimates of gross proved and probable, recoverable natural gas reserves in its Madison reservoir to in excess of one trillion cubic feet from 200 billion, the company said in a statement.
The company drilled a step out well in the Madden Field in Fremont County, Wyoming which revealed a gas column of 260 feet with no water present.

LL&E is the operator with a 38 percent working interest in this well, others are W.A. Moncrief, Jr. with 36 percent, North Central Oil Corporation with 14 and BHP Petroleum (Americas) Inc with 12. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
